hero.desc: A YOLOv5-based deep learning model integrating separable convolutions to accurately localize and count wheat heads from field images — built for agronomists, researchers, and breeders.
features.title: Built for real field conditions
features.desc: Trained on diverse, occluded, and densely-packed wheat head imagery for robust, real-world performance.
feature.1.title: Separable Convolutions
feature.1.desc: Lightweight depthwise-separable layers cut compute cost while preserving detection accuracy.
feature.2.title: Real-time Inference
feature.2.desc: Optimized YOLOv5 backbone delivers fast, on-demand predictions on a single image or live feed.
feature.3.title: Dense Head Counting
feature.3.desc: Handles overlapping and occluded wheat heads for reliable yield estimation.
cta.title: Ready to see it in action?
cta.desc: Upload a field image and get instant wheat head detections with bounding boxes.
upload.title: Upload a wheat field image
upload.subtitle: JPG or PNG, up to 10MB. The model returns bounding boxes over detected wheat heads.
upload.drop_sub: or click to browse from your device
upload.result_sub: Bounding boxes are drawn over each detected wheat head.
upload.result_empty: Your detection result will appear here
upload.toast_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
about.title: Wheat Head Detection, explained
about.desc: This project applies a YOLOv5 object detector — enhanced with separable convolutions — to identify and count wheat heads in field photography, supporting yield estimation and crop research workflows.
about.stack_desc: PyTorch, YOLOv5, OpenCV, and Flask power the model training pipeline and this web interface.
about.data_desc: Trained on thousands of annotated field images captured under varied lighting, density, and occlusion conditions.
about.goal_desc: Give researchers and farmers a fast, accessible way to estimate wheat head counts from a single photo.
auth.signin_sub: Sign in to access the detection dashboard
auth.signup_sub: Join to start detecting wheat heads
footer.tagline: Precision agriculture, powered by computer vision.
